plan.title: eRFX RFQ surrogate bid for Vendor A

steps.note: Open the existing prepared RFQ event directly on its Participants screen.
Place the buyer's surrogate bid for the next eligible vendor, representing Vendor A when no vendor name is supplied.
Assert that the bid submission was accepted.
Verify the RFQ response is present and marked as a surrogate bid.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid for the submitted bid.
Assert that the submitted bid is ranked in Master QCS.
